verdict.rationale: Supabase Database Webhooks are a first-party feature that automatically sends data to another system whenever a table event occurs. That is a genuine event-triggered action, but the evidence covers only database table events with an outbound send as the action. Cron is time-scheduled, not event-driven, so it does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documented rule/condition definition beyond table events, broader event sources and action types, depth of docs on configuring triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.
